newsitem.title: USA: Atlantis Plastics suspends share buybacks.
newsitem.headline: Atlantis Plastics suspends share buybacks.

text.p: Atlantis Plastics Inc said Tuesday it had suspended its share repurchase program until it meets the requirements laid out in its debt covenants.
The company said in a statement that it is no longer meeting a fixed charge ratio for the trailing 12-month period ended July 30 on its $100 million, 11 percent senior notes due 2003.
Atlantis said it has already repurchased, starting in November 1996, 320,344 common shares and options for 55,125 shares. It said it had authorized one million shares for repurchase.
The company said the suspension will remain in effect until it is able to meet the requirements on a 12-month trailing basis.
